result.question: Why did God cause the leaders of Shechem to treat Abimelech deceitfully?

readings.answer: To bring the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal to justice and avenge their blood on Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem.
readings.support: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem

assessments.reason: It restates verse 9:24’s purpose clause that the crime against Jerubbaal’s seventy sons come to justice and their blood be avenged; adding “on Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem” is supported by the verse.

result.reason: Verse 9:24 explicitly gives the reason: so the crime would come to justice and their blood be avenged.
